name: Cornelius a Lapide
bio:
Flemish Jesuit, born Cornelis Cornelissen van den Steen, who taught Scripture at Louvain and then at the Roman College in Rome.

His Latin commentaries cover every book of the Catholic canon except Job and the Psalms. They gather the Fathers' readings, older and newer interpreters, and moral and spiritual applications for preachers, and were reprinted for three centuries.
